title: How long will you go on talking

request.style: English, male soul vocal, deep and reflective, solo with choir support, acoustic piano, cello, upright bass, light percussion, gentle and solemn mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Three friends came from far away
Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar too
They saw his pain from a distance away
Could not recognize the man he knew

[Chorus]
How long will you go on talking like this
Your words are a driving wind
Does God pervert justice in his design
Does the Almighty let what is right be blind

[Verse]
They wept aloud and tore their robes
Tossed dust into the air above
Sat with him for seven days and nights
No words were spoken, suffering in sight

[Chorus]
How long will you go on talking like this
Your words are a driving wind
Does God pervert justice in his design
Does the Almighty let what is right be blind

[Bridge]
Can papyrus grow where there is no marsh
Can reeds flourish without water
The hope of the godless perishes
Their trust is a spider's web

[Chorus]
How long will you go on talking like this
Your words are a driving wind
Does God pervert justice in his design
Does the Almighty let what is right be blind

[Outro]
Take seven bulls and seven rams
Go to my servant Job
He will pray for you
And the LORD will accept his prayer
